description: This file contains function prototypes and macro definitions for the Beep Service Bean Object API, used in the BSP execution environment. It declares functions for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the Service Bean Object, and serves as an interface specification for components interacting with this object.

methods.name: BeepCreateServiceBean
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Beep Service Bean Object, takes container, owner, and reserved handles as parameters.

methods.name: BeepSboCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Beep Service Bean Object, takes container, owner, and reserved handles as parameters.

methods.name: BeepSboRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified Beep Service Bean Object instance.

methods.name: BeepSboEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls the necessary objects into the Beep Service Bean Object.

methods.name: BeepSboInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Beep Service Bean Object.
